overall_goal: Stir the salad, add the dressing, and mix everything together

goals.description: Stir the salad ingredients before adding dressing
goals.rationale: The person prepares the salad for the dressing by stirring the ingredients together.

goals.description: Open the dressing canister and scoop the dressing into the salad
goals.rationale: The person opens the dressing container and transfers the dressing from the canister into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Scrape the remaining dressing from the lid and mix the salad
goals.rationale: The person scrapes the last bits of dressing from the lid into the bowl and then stirs everything together.
